messages.subject: Re: rtools on windows

On Thursday, July 16, 2015 at 3:55:33 PM UTC-4, Jiqiang Guo wrote:
> It turns out it's a false alarm.  I had another gcc 4.6.3 somehow installed by some perl program, which doesn't work for stan.  But I thought it's in rtools.
>

The current Rtools is still based on 4.6.3, and development of the 4.9-based branch has stalled, although it does exist (and I have a local copy from a while ago if anyone needs). You probably had both in your PATH and something was conflicting.
